reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:ea99b2bd1d0e6ab19e408a4f0463a55f]] Very soft fibers, love the color, the only thing that kinda sucks about it is is that the brushes are very repetitive. They are all almost the same brush. But for 8 bucks it’s a good kit. Just of course not pro brushes

reviews.t: Good set of brushes at a reasonable price!
reviews.x: This set my husband bought me for a no special occasion gift. Seeing I wasnt able to afford the morphe brushes i had been wanting for awhile, and being that we are on a tight budget, he searched on here for a good set of brushes. He ordered these for me and surprised me with them. I was so skeptical at first, however i did appreciate his thought of me. I quickly unpacked them and went upstairs to my vanity and laid them out. I applied my makeup and quickly decided these were and are good brushes

These are decent for the price, buttt you get a lot of the same brush in different sizes. I’m really missing a good fluffy blending eyeshadow brush from this set, and just wish it was more. So far they’ve held up. They’re very light-weight.

These suck so bad! Everything about them are crap. Save ur money do not buy these. Ive had mine for a little while and tried to really give them a chance but i only kept 1 of the brushes that i use to put my facemasks on. All of the othera i either threw away bc they come apart or gave to my 7 yr old for her to do her makeup with!

reviews.t: Didn’t like the variety and quality
reviews.x: Beautiful colors but the brushes weren’t any good quality. The handles came of on some of them already. And almost all of them were the same flat angled brushes but different sizes. I was hoping they were different style for different uses. I won’t buy them again because I have no use for 20 of them out of 32pc.
The quality is definitely not very good, but the price was as cheap so it is a bargain you take. The package smelled very strong like vinegar when opened, took a day to air out and not smell awful
Most the brushes broke within the first use. I have had to glue the brushes back onto the wooden stick on 3/4 of them.  :*(

reviews.t: Would I purchase this product again? No.
reviews.x: The bristles on the brushes are not as expected.

reviews.t: Great brush set for peeps not so picky about makeup brushes
reviews.x: I love these brushes. I spent such a long time reading the reviews and just decided to buy these despite any negative review. Yes, the roll up bag they come in stinks to high heaven BUT since each brush had a protective plastic sleeve on it, it kept the brushes themselves from smelling. The two fan brushes did smell a tiny bit because the covers slid down in shipping but a good air dry fixed it. I tossed the roll up bag in my attic to air out ... if the smell goes away I will keep it just in cas

I honestly love that the brushes feel very soft and even look soft to begin with.For the travel bag, I see it very helpful! It’s not too big and is able to fit right into a purse or backpack!  And it even protects the brushes from getting damaged. I personally think the price was very good for the quality, especially because there’s different types of brushes from big to small.

Came in neat packaging and allowed you to put your brushes in the order you preferred. The bristles are incredibly smooth and yes there are some repeat brushes, but I LOVE THAT because I basically have the same brush I can put different colors on. It provided a beautiful application and were incredibly sturdy. I love these brushes and will purchase more when these get worn out.

I am a makeup artist and I broke one of my brushes so I decided to buy a cheap version of it and to be honest I am pretty surprised by the quality of this product. For the price of one brand brush you can have this full kit that is such a good quality. For the price it it pretty impressive.

Nice quality brushes. I washed them as soon as I got them because I know they have been handled and shipped and they washed nicely. They are very soft and you get a good variation of brushes for the price.
I love these brushes so much! They just came in and I’m so excited to use them. The color is beautiful, and you can use them for a variety amount of things. Definitely worth the money
I do not recommend  these brushes they are hard, not flexible and fall apart upon washing. yes they are cute but not worth the money.
Had a strange smell at first but it goes away and they work just as well if not better that some of my expensive brushes
They completely fall apart. The ends are made of wood and they are poorly hot glue gunned on the brush piece. Worthless.
good set of brushes. its not as soft for my personal preference..but its good enough for the price..
I don't like it. The eyeshadow brush doesn't get the color. It's very thick brush. It's not soft
These brushes are not good don’t waste your money.. they don’t work well with high end make up.
Lov the color love the durability of them also.

reviews.t: these are fabulous for the price!
reviews.x: I love the sizes because I use a lot of eye shadow colors, these work perfectly, there's a lot of smaller size brushes which is exactly what I wanted for eyes and lips. There was no chemical smell in mine. The hairs don't fall out when pulled, soft bristles. I was pleasantly surprised when I got them. I also like the shorter handles, I prefer them that way.  I don't know what people had to complain about, at this price they are great! as you can see from the pics I like makeup, and these worked

To be honest, I bought these to paint with. I saw the potential for blending and shading with these, and I was not wrong. But it really is a great value for any purpose. It's a LOT of brushes for the price, they are well made, resilient, and so far have not shed. And they come with a nice travel roll to hold them all. It's a wide range of shapes and sizes, and there are some nice big fluffy blenders as well as smaller applicators for eye makeup and mascara. I think it's an excellent value.

These brushes don’t apply eyeshadow well. My colors looked muddy and the eyeshadow ended up everywhere except where I was trying to apply it. I attempted to pack the shadow onto the brush and my eye so there would be a little bit of color but it was useless. This set is not worth it. I’m not sure what I was expecting for the price, but this was not it.

reviews.t: Overall it's ok but pre small
reviews.x: These brushes are small..... quite a bit smaller than a standard makeup brush. They are soft but not great at blending. There are a couple in the set that I do like to use for adding a darker come to the creases of my eyes. The cheek brushes seem to work better for blending eyeshadow. Overall it's ok so I'll keep the set for backup and maybe travel.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the brushes soft and good value for the low price.
A common complaint is that the set contains many repetitive brushes of nearly the same style.
Several reviewers report poor durability, with brushes breaking, handles coming off, or falling apart.
Some reviewers note an unpleasant vinegar-like smell, especially from the bag.
Some reviewers praise the color and packaging, including the travel bag.
